title: Starting a Halal Business
description: How to start a halal business in the modern economy: the most blessed forms of earning according to the Qur'an and Sunnah, what is prohibited in trade and commerce, halal side-income ideas, and the wisdom of honest trade from Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem, plus practical guidance from Islamic Finance Guru. Salafi-scholar-verified content.
short_description: Build a halal business the Islamic way

modules.title: Understanding Halal Trade
modules.description: What makes a business halal: blessed trades, what is allowed and forbidden.

lessons.title: How Can We Be Successful in Business in a Halal Way?
lessons.content: Principles for a halal business: choosing blessed trades and honest transaction methods. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: What Is the Most Blessed Business According to Qur'an and Sunnah?
lessons.content: Comparison of business models and the prophet's love for honest trade - especially agriculture and trade. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: Can We Purchase Things or Do Business with Enemies of Islam?
lessons.content: Engaging in trade with non-Muslims including enemies of Islam: the ruling according to the Qur'an and Sunnah. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: Ruling on Being an Agent / Middlemen and Making Profit on Products You Don't Possess
lessons.content: Middleman agency (samsarah) and earning profit without possessing the goods: what is allowed and what is riba/gharar. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

modules.title: The Halal Founder
modules.description: Halal earning, employed income, and intentional entrepreneurship.

lessons.title: Every Time I Find a Job I Find Something Haram in It (Is Everything Halal by Default?)
lessons.content: When every employment option seems compromised: what to do - the default ruling for work is halal unless proven otherwise. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: Can We Take Money or Benefit from Someone Whose Income Includes Riba?
lessons.content: Receiving benefit (a loan, gift, or profit) from someone working in riba-based systems - what is permitted and what is not. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
